newsitem.title: USA: Philly controller, Pittsburgh mayor win primaries.
newsitem.headline: Philly controller, Pittsburgh mayor win primaries.

text.p: Philadelphia's incumbent City Controller Jonathan Saidel and Pittsburgh Mayor Tom Murphy won Democratic primaries Tuesday for reelection.

Saidel was able to stave off a scandal involving loans to his campaign treasurer to win a chance to be the Democratic standard-bearer this fall. He will run in the general election against Republican Bill O'Brien.

In Pittsburgh, incumbent Mayor Tom Murphy was seen taking the primary with more than 51 percent of the vote. Murphy's closest challenger was Pittsburgh City Councilman Bob O'Connor, who had 42 percent of the vote.
